tools.name: search_camps
tools.description: Search kids' camp sessions in the Washington DC / Maryland / Virginia area by location, dates, ages, categories, and price. Location is required: pass a 5-digit ZIP code (or lat+lon, or city+state). With start_date/end_date, results are individual sessions (10 per page); without dates, results are o

tools.name: find_camp_by_name
tools.description: Look up camps by camp or organization name when the parent already knows (roughly) what the camp is called. Tolerates misspellings. Returns matching camps ranked by similarity — use get_camp_details on a result for sessions, prices, and availability. For discovery by area, use search_camps instead.

tools.name: get_camp_details
tools.description: Get the full profile of one camp: description, organizer, parent rating, and its sessions with dates, the camp's listed prices (US dollars, price_usd_min/max), registration_status, bookability and booking_mode (native | platform_deeplink | listing_only; platform_deeplink sessions carry the platform'

tools.name: get_sessions_and_availability
tools.description: Check live bookability, pricing (US dollars), remaining spots, and refund policy for up to 20 sessions at once. price_usd / deposit_usd are the camp's own prices; for sessions booked on kiddinglab.com, parent_price_usd / parent_deposit_usd are what the parent pays before tax, including Kiddinglab's

tools.name: get_booking_policies
tools.description: Get the refund policy, payment schedule, waiver requirement, and platform payment facts for one session, including what the parent pays: parent_price_usd (and parent_deposit_usd) include Kiddinglab's 1.5% service fee, before tax; price_usd is the camp's own price. Parents review, sign, and pay on ki

tools.name: create_booking_handoff
tools.description: Create a prefilled checkout link for 1-6 bookable sessions (booking_mode native) and share it with the parent. This is a shopping-list prefill, NOT a reservation: no spots are held, and the parent signs in, names their campers, signs waivers, and pays on kiddinglab.com. The response totals are in US

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_camps, get_booking_policies · Public sink: create_booking_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_camps, get_booking_policies · Public sink: create_booking_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_camps" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
